programs.title: Charade
programs.desc: Romance and intrigue ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want to get their hands on a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. She soon loses trust in those who claim they want to help her.

programs.title: Pawparazzi
programs.desc: London Bridges, a fast rising Hollywood starlet, with her pampered pomeranian Latte in tow, arrives on location for "There Will Be Oil" and finds that she won't be receiving the star treatment that she is used to. AKA PupParazzi

programs.title: Ozzy
programs.desc: When his family goes on vacation, a young dog finds himself at a dog prison where he must escape with the help of his new friends.

programs.title: In The Doghouse
programs.desc: A divorced mom decides to re-enter the dating scene, but her kids, along with their dog, are on a mission to ruin her dates. They're pretty successful until her old high school love comes back into the picture. He knows what the kids are up to, and they all get caught up in a funny showdown to win mom's heart back, hoping she'll choose their dad over her former flame.

programs.title: McLintock!
programs.desc: Wealthy rancher G. W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.

programs.title: Bad Man's River
programs.desc: Robber Roy King loses his wife, Alicia, to revolutionary Montero. Despite their rivalry they collaborate in an attempt to rob the Mexican government of one million dollars.
